title: OceanBench challenger registry
description: challengers.json (contracts.md §2): the in-repo, versioned registry mapping a canonical challenger slug to its metadata. Baselines (climatology, persistence) are challengers with is_baseline true. One slug per challenger everywhere (paths, parquet, catalog).

is_baseline.description: True for baseline challengers (climatology, persistence) from which skill scores are derived at display time.

nominal_resolution_deg.description: Nominal grid resolution in degrees (e.g. 0.25, 0.0833). Each challenger is scored on its native grid.

lead_days.description: Number of 1-based lead days the forecast provides (typically 10).

source.description: Location of the forecast outputs (e.g. an s3:// prefix).
